name: European Space Agency
body: HSTS, robots.txt open to AI answer crawlers, and a description on the home page. But the site search on every page read is a text field named only by its "Search ESA" placeholder.
lesson: Add a visible label or aria-label to the search field. Screen readers announce the name, not the hint.
summary: www.esa.int scores 74 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 25 are at risk, and 16 pass. Fix first: 20 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 20 form controls have no label
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages read.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 92 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

fix.title: 20 pages have no canonical link
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 359 ms
